name: search_listings
title: Search Northern Cyprus property listings
description: Search live Evlek property listings for sale and long-term rent in Northern Cyprus (KKTC/TRNC; prices in GBP unless a currency is given; 2+1 means bedrooms 2) with structured filters: transaction, city, district, property type, bedrooms, price, areas, amenities, nearby university. Pass the user's language as `locale` (tr|en|ru|de|ar): the text, amenity names, number formats and links follow it. Returns at most 10 listings per call, each as one readable line (type, place, price, rooms, area, a deterministic sentence, data notes, canonical link) plus a structured card; continue with the `nextCursor` of a group. Without `transaction`, listings for sale and for rent come as two separate groups, each with its own cursor that is only valid together with that group's transaction. Place names in any language are resolved; an unknown place returns suggestions instead of results. An amenity that cannot be filtered on is reported as not applied. For a free-text request use `search`; for one listing use `fetch` or `get_listing`. Returns advertised asking-price and listing facts only: not a valuation, verification of property-specific claims, forecast, ranking or recommendation.

inputSchema.description: Structured search over active Evlek property listings in Northern Cyprus (sale and long-term rent; holiday lets are not offered). Every field is optional; a listing must match ALL the fields you set. `transaction` is required when you filter or sort by price or page with `cursor`. At most 10 listings are returned per call; continue with `cursor`. Sort orders: newest = latest first (default), price-low = cheapest first, price-high = most expensive first, price-per-sqm-asc = lowest price per m², area-large / area-small = largest / smallest closed area, nearest-uni = closest to a university. Pass `locale` in the language the user writes in.

transaction.description: 'sale' or 'rent' (long-term). REQUIRED with priceMin, priceMax, a price sort or cursor. Omit only to browse both together.

city.description: City names in any language, e.g. ["Girne"] or ["Kyrenia", "Famagusta"]; ANY match counts. Towns and villages go in `district`.

district.description: Districts, towns or villages in any language, e.g. ["Alsancak"]; ANY match counts. With city ["Girne"], ["Merkez"] means Girne Merkez.

propertyType.description: Property types, ANY match: single types or groups (house, land, commercial), e.g. ["apartment", "penthouse"] or ["house"].

items.description: A property type, or a group: house = villa, detached, bungalow; land = residential_land, commercial_land, farmland; commercial = shop, office, warehouse, whole_building, hotel.

bedrooms.description: Bedrooms as an object: {"exact": 3}, {"min": 2} or {"min": 2, "max": 4}; integers 0-20. Use exact for "a 3-bedroom".

exact.description: Exact number of bedrooms; 0 means a studio. Cannot be combined with min or max.

areaMin.description: Minimum CLOSED (built, indoor) area in m², inclusive. For plots and gardens use landAreaMin instead.

areaMax.description: Maximum closed (built, indoor) area in m², inclusive.

landAreaMin.description: Minimum plot (land) area in m², inclusive: villas, houses, bungalows and land.

landAreaMax.description: Maximum plot (land) area in m², inclusive.

priceMin.description: Minimum price, inclusive, in `currency`: the asking price for sale, the monthly rent for rent. Requires `transaction`.

priceMax.description: Maximum price, inclusive, in `currency` ("under 300000" → 300000): the asking price for sale, the monthly rent for rent. Requires `transaction`.

currency.description: Currency of priceMin and priceMax: GBP (default), EUR, USD or TRY. Converted to GBP on the server at the current Evlek rate.

features.description: Amenities the listing must have (ALL must match), any language, e.g. ["pool", "sea view", "elevator"]. Others are reported as not filterable.

items.description: An amenity name in any language. Only these can be filtered: Furnished, Fridge, Washing Machine, Dishwasher, Air Conditioning, Television, Bed, Desk, Wi-Fi, Smart Home, Central Heating, Garden, Terrace, Parking, Pool, Elevator, Security/CCTV, Generator, Sea View, Bills Included, Available Now. Any other amenity is reported as not filterable.

furnished.description: true = furnished listings only, false = unfurnished only. Omit for both.

billsIncluded.description: Rentals only: true = the rent includes utility bills. Without `transaction` the search is limited to rent.

availableNow.description: Rentals only: true = can be moved into immediately. Without `transaction` the search is limited to rent.

noDeposit.description: Rentals only: true = no security deposit is required.

contractType.description: Contract type. Rentals: 'monthly', 'semester' or 'yearly'. Sales: 'cash' or 'installment'. Must fit `transaction`.

nearUniversity.description: Listings close to one university, e.g. {"code": "NEU", "maxMeters": 1000}. Useful for student housing.

code.description: University code: NEU = Near East University, DAU = Eastern Mediterranean University, GAU = Girne American University, CIU = Cyprus International University, EUL = European University of Lefke, BAU = BAU Cyprus University, AKU = University of Mediterranean Karpasia.

maxMeters.description: Maximum distance to that university in metres, at least 250 (default 2000; the site offers 500, 1000 and 2000). Listing distances are rounded up to 250 m steps.

bbox.description: Map rectangle in Northern Cyprus, WGS84 degrees: {west, south, east, north}. For "this map area" only; otherwise use city and district.

west.description: Left edge, longitude in decimal degrees (32.7 to 34.65). Must be smaller than east.

south.description: Bottom edge, latitude in decimal degrees (34.95 to 35.78). Must be smaller than north.

east.description: Right edge, longitude in decimal degrees. Must be larger than west.

north.description: Top edge, latitude in decimal degrees. Must be larger than south.

sort.description: Order, default 'newest'. price-low = cheapest first, price-high = dearest first (both need transaction); others: see schema description.

limit.description: Number of listings to return, 1-10 (default 8, maximum 10). Ask for more with `cursor`, never with a larger limit.

cursor.description: Pass the previous `nextCursor` with the SAME filters, sort and transaction. Opaque: never build or edit it. Requires `transaction`.

locale.description: Language of the response text, feature names, number formats and links: tr, en, ru, de, ar (default en). Pass the language the user is writing in.

total.description: Public listings matching the filters, summed over the groups.

totalMatched.description: The same number as `total` (the v2 name).

groups.description: One group per transaction: two (sale, rent) when no transaction was given.

transactionImplied.description: True when the transaction was implied by the filters (a rental-only fact), not sent: the cursor then carries it.

impliedTransaction.description: Present when no transaction was sent and the search was limited to one because of the filters.

matchedFeatures.description: The requested amenities this listing has, in request order (canonical keys); empty when none were requested.

appliedFilters.description: What the database was really asked, in the query parameter names (place names as resolved). Only the filters that were applied are present.

unappliedFilters.description: Constraints that were NOT applied (an amenity that cannot be filtered on, text the parser could not read). The listings shown may not honour them.

code.description: Present on a soft result (INVALID_LOCATION, OUT_OF_SCOPE, FX_UNAVAILABLE, ...).

contentLocale.description: The language the listing pages (links, descriptions) resolved to: `locale` when every shown listing has a page in it, the fallback (Turkish) when none does, null when they differ (each card has its own).

localeFallback.description: True when a listing link or description is in another language because it has no translation in `locale`.

name: search
title: Search Evlek property listings
description: Search live Northern Cyprus (KKTC/TRNC) property listings on Evlek with a free-text query in Turkish, English, Russian, German or Arabic. Returns matching listings as id/title/url for the fetch tool, newest first (sale and rent as two groups when the query names neither). The answer language follows the language of the query. Same data as search_listings: this fixed form exists for the ChatGPT/OpenAI connector contract. Use when: the caller only has a free-text query ("2+1 apartment in Kyrenia under 150000 pounds", "EVL-100464"). Don't use for: structured filters, paging or another answer language: use search_listings.

total.description: Public listings matching the filters, summed over the groups.

totalMatched.description: The same number as `total` (the v2 name).

groups.description: One group per transaction: two (sale, rent) when no transaction was given.

transactionImplied.description: True when the transaction was implied by the filters (a rental-only fact), not sent: the cursor then carries it.

impliedTransaction.description: Present when no transaction was sent and the search was limited to one because of the filters.

matchedFeatures.description: The requested amenities this listing has, in request order (canonical keys); empty when none were requested.

appliedFilters.description: What the database was really asked, in the query parameter names (place names as resolved). Only the filters that were applied are present.

unappliedFilters.description: Constraints that were NOT applied (an amenity that cannot be filtered on, text the parser could not read). The listings shown may not honour them.

code.description: Present on a soft result (INVALID_LOCATION, OUT_OF_SCOPE, FX_UNAVAILABLE, ...).

contentLocale.description: The language the listing pages (links, descriptions) resolved to: `locale` when every shown listing has a page in it, the fallback (Turkish) when none does, null when they differ (each card has its own).

localeFallback.description: True when a listing link or description is in another language because it has no translation in `locale`.

criteria.description: Everything the sentence was understood as, with the words each came from.

unresolved.description: Words that did NOT become a filter, with the reason.

clarifications.description: Questions to ask the user instead of guessing.

assumed.description: What had to be assumed to make a constraint a filter (a currency, a band, a period).

lookup.description: Present for an explicit listing number ("EVL-100464").

message.description: The reason, in the answer language, when there is nothing to list (content[0].text stays the connector JSON).

nearbyAlternatives.description: Only when nothing matched: ONE relaxation (district dropped, else budget + 15 %), at most 5 listings.

matchedFeatures.description: The requested amenities this listing has, in request order (canonical keys); empty when none were requested.

name: fetch
title: Fetch full Evlek listing detail
description: Fetch the full detail of one Evlek listing: title, price, location, rooms, areas, amenities, data-quality notes and the canonical link. The id is the listing id (UUID) from a search result, a listing number such as EVL-100464, or an evlek.app listing link; the answer language follows the link (English otherwise). A listing that is not available (it does not exist, is not public, or was removed) always gets the same answer. Same data as get_listing: this fixed id-only form exists for the ChatGPT/OpenAI connector contract. Use when: an id from search is known. Don't use for: discovery (use search first) or another answer language (use get_listing).

id.description: Evlek listing id (UUID) from search, a listing number such as EVL-100464, or an evlek.app listing link

metadata.description: Listing facts (price, rooms, area, features, data quality); no contact data.

code.description: NOT_FOUND or SEARCH_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE, when there is no listing to describe.

matchedFeatures.description: The requested amenities this listing has, in request order (canonical keys); empty when none were requested.

listing.description: The listing card (same shape as search_listings).

requested.description: The id as the caller sent it (cleaned, at most 200 characters).

name: get_listing
title: Get an Evlek listing
description: Get the full details of ONE public Evlek listing (sale or long-term rent) in the user's language. `ref` is the listing id (UUID), the listing number (EVL-100464 or just 100464) or an evlek.app listing link in any language. Returns the price, rooms, bathrooms, built area and plot area (always separate), the approximate location, features, the office name, dates, data-quality notes, photos with captions where they exist, AI virtual-staging before/after images when the office approved them (always labelled as AI-generated) and the canonical link. Contact details are never included: send the user to the link. A listing that is unknown or no longer public answers found:false with code NOT_FOUND (this is not an error). Pass the user's language as `locale` (tr, en, ru, de or ar).

ref.description: The listing: its id (UUID), its listing number (EVL-100464 or 100464) or an evlek.app listing link in any language.

locale.description: Language of the answer and of the links. Pass the language the user writes in. Default en.

code.description: When found is false: NOT_FOUND (the listing does not exist or is not public), SEARCH_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE, INVALID_PARAMS or INTERNAL_ERROR.

requested.description: The identifier the caller sent, when found is false.

retryable.description: True when found is false because the search backend could not answer (code SEARCH_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE).

perSqmGbp.description: Null whenever the built area is flagged suspect.

url.description: The canonical link of the listing page in contentLocale.

contentLocale.description: The language the listing page and url really resolved to.

pricePerSqmGbp.description: Null whenever the built area is flagged suspect.

areaSqm.description: The BUILT area in m²; null on land (see plotM2). The number is shown even when areaSuspect is true.

virtualStaging.description: Present only when approved AI virtual-staging images exist. Every image is AI-generated and must be shown with the disclosure.

name: compare_listings
title: Compare Evlek listings
description: Compare 2 to 4 public Evlek listings side by side in the user's language: price, price per m² (only when the built area is believable), rooms, bathrooms, built area and plot area (always separate), location, furnishing, key features and data-quality notes, plus a few descriptive highlights (lowest price, largest indoor area, most recently listed). `ids` takes listing ids (UUID), listing numbers (EVL-100464) or evlek.app listing links, in any mix; the order you give is kept. Sale and rent listings are never ranked against each other: a mixed request is shown in two groups with a warning. A reference that is unknown or no longer public is listed in `missingIds` with code NOT_FOUND (this is not an error). Descriptive facts only: no valuation and no recommendation. Pass the user's language as `locale` (tr, en, ru, de or ar).

items.description: A listing id (UUID), a listing number (EVL-100464) or an evlek.app listing link.

ids.description: 2 to 4 listings, in any mix of ids, numbers and links. The order is kept.

locale.description: Language of the answer and of the links. Pass the language the user writes in. Default en.

code.description: Absent on a comparison. NOT_ENOUGH_LISTINGS when fewer than two of the requested listings are available; SEARCH_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE, INVALID_PARAMS or INTERNAL_ERROR otherwise.

retryable.description: True when the search backend could not answer (code SEARCH_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE).

compared.description: The listings that were compared, in the order of the request.

pricePerSqmGbp.description: GBP per m²; null whenever the built area is flagged suspect.

areaSqm.description: The BUILT area in m²; null on land (see plotM2). Shown even when areaSuspect is true.

groups.description: The compared listings by transaction (sale and rent are never ranked against each other).

missingIds.description: One NOT_FOUND entry per requested reference that names no public listing.

contentLocale.description: The language every link resolved to; null when the listings differ (see compared[].contentLocale).

localeFallback.description: True when at least one link opens a page in another language than requested.

name: market_stats
title: Northern Cyprus market statistics
description: Market statistics for Northern Cyprus from asking prices of active public listings (not sales, valuations or forecasts). No city = the island by city; one city = its districts; several = side by side; city + district = a district profile. Sale and rent are reported separately. Each figure has activeCount (public listings in scope) and sampleCount (the cleaned sample behind the statistic); below 10 sampled listings it is withheld. Pass locale.

city.description: City names in any language, e.g. ["Girne"]. One gives its districts, two or more are compared (max 6). Omit for the whole island.

items.description: A city name, e.g. Girne, Kyrenia, Gazimağusa, Famagusta.

district.description: A district, village or region (Alsancak, Long Beach, Karpaz) for a profile. The city is inferred when the name is unambiguous.

transaction.description: 'sale' or 'rent' (long-term). Omit for both: they are reported separately and never mixed.

propertyType.description: Limit to property types or groups, e.g. ["apartment"] or ["house"]. Price statistics cover residential types only.

items.description: A property type (apartment, villa, penthouse, studio, ...) or a group (house, land, commercial).

locale.description: Language of the answer text, number formats and links (default en). Pass the language the user is writing in.

type.description: The deal of `cities` (sale when both were asked for).

totals.description: Per deal: activeCount and sampleCount summed over the scope.

cityName.description: Display name in the answer language.

activeCount.description: Every public listing in the scope (any property type).

sampleCount.description: The cleaned sample the statistic is based on. Not an active count.

exclusions.description: nRaw, nUnique, nDuplicates, nIqrExcluded, nOtherExcluded and nNotIndexEligible (= activeCount - nRaw); null when the engine has no waterfall.

status.description: Capped at preliminary when one office dominates the sample (statusNote single_office).

items.description: district, districtId and the same statistic fields.

additionalDeals.description: The other deal when both were asked for: the same rows as `cities`.

items.description: { type, cities } with the same city rows as `cities`.

district.description: District profile: sale and rent statistics, personas, asking-rent ratio and listing details.

code.description: On a soft answer: INVALID_LOCATION, OUT_OF_SCOPE or SEARCH_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.

items.description: code, field, message and, where there is one, allowedValues and suggestion.

name: list_locations

Call it first when unsure how a place is spelled: every name and id returned is accepted by the other tools. Pass `city` (any spelling or language) for one place in detail. Names are Turkish or Latin; Russian, German and Arabic spellings are accepted as input but not listed.

includeEmpty.description: Also list places that have no public listing right now. Default false.

name: convert_currency
title: Currency conversion (GBP/EUR/USD/TRY)
description: Converts an amount between GBP, EUR, USD and TRY with the exchange rates Evlek stores (refreshed daily) and returns all four equivalents. Currency conversion only: no payment plan, deposit or instalment schedule, tax, fee or acquisition-cost estimate, no advice. Rates older than 24 hours are flagged as stale; beyond 72 hours (or when none are stored) no conversion is produced (FX_UNAVAILABLE).

amount.description: Amount to convert: a property price, a monthly rent, any amount from 1 up. Not a deposit or an instalment plan.

currency.description: Currency of the amount. Default GBP. Lower case, symbols (£ € $ ₺) and names (pound, euro, dollar, lira) are read.

locale.description: Language of the answer and the number format. Pass the language the user writes in. Default en.

priceGBP.description: The amount in GBP (the same number as amounts.GBP).

asOf.description: When the rates were stored (ISO 8601, UTC).

rates.description: Units of each currency per 1 GBP, as stored.

stale.description: True when the rates are older than 24 hours (at most 72 hours: older ones are refused).

ageHours.description: Whole hours since the rates were stored.

stale.description: True when the stored rates are older than 24 hours.

assumedCurrency.description: True when no currency was given and GBP was assumed.

code.description: Present on a soft refusal (FX_UNAVAILABLE) and on invalid arguments (INVALID_PARAMS).

rateAgeHours.description: FX_UNAVAILABLE with reason too_old: how old the stored rates are, in hours.
